name: STL-10
description: Image recognition dataset of 10 classes, containing labeled training and test images and a larger set of unlabeled images for unsupervised learning.
citation: Coates, A., Ng, A., & Lee, H. (2011). An Analysis of Single-Layer Networks in Unsupervised Feature Learning. Proceedings of the Fourteenth International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS), 15, 215–223.
